subject: textbox "Member Number" within "Member Number Search"
reason: policy heritage-core-default permits fill (risky) on http://127.0.0.1:53600 — Every field this deployment's capabilities fill is a search field on a query form — member number, account number — and filling one commits nothing on its own. It is classified risky because a value typed into the wrong box is how a transfer acquires the wrong payee, and because the values are member data. The control that keeps that from happening is the Target robustness argument recorded against each fill in its Capability Artifact, which a reviewer approves before the artifact runs.

subject: button "Search" within "Member Number Search"
reason: policy heritage-core-default permits click (risky) on http://127.0.0.1:53600 — Clicking is how a search is submitted and how an account is opened from a member's list, and there is no way to read a balance out of Heritage Core without doing both. It is the action that actually commits, so the capabilities approved for unattended replay are read-only ones: nothing in artifacts/ presses a control that posts a transaction. That is a property of the approved artifacts rather than of this line, which is why the artifacts are reviewed and versioned.
